messages:
akira: quick flag: nova-lite-v1 int8 bring-up (kernel q5x) is showing boundary collapses on mixed JP+KR inputs when context > 512. saw this in the longform translation suite.

lina: how bad? any perf tradeoff?

akira: small summary: FP16 baseline sacrebleu=31.4, chrF=0.702. int8 (q5x) -> sacrebleu=28.6 (-2.8), chrF=0.665 (-0.037). breakdown shows most hits on sequences containing furigana/ruby + trailing hangul jamo blocks.

noah: sample? even a short snippet helps triage.

akira: pasted a minimal triplet below (source has kana ruby and a following hangul cluster):

```
SRC: [furigana][kanji][/furigana] [hangul][/hangul]
REF: [kanji](furigana) \uac00\uac01.
FP16: [kanji](furigana) \uac00\uac01.
INT8: [kanji](furigana)\uac00\uac01.
```

akira: note the missing separator that was present in fp16 output; shows up intermittently after ~600 tokens.

lina: do encode/decode token ids differ?

noah: grabbed tokenizer dump from canary run: 

```
# encode(source)
FP16 ids: [11, 2203, 7890, 44, 3013, 9002]
INT8 ids: [11, 2203, 7890, 44, 3013, 9002]
# offsets fp16: [(0,3),(3,8),(8,10),(10,11),(11,14),(14,18)]
# offsets int8: [(0,3),(3,8),(8,11),(11,14),(14,18)]
```

noah: offsets disagree: int8 merged two subtokens into one offset (8,11) -> explains the glued output. encode path is same; decode/offset-assembly differs.

akira: runtime logs show repeated lines from kv-assembler: `WARN kvcache: align_shift_detected shard=1 step=42 delta=1` and sometimes `WARN quant: per_token_scale_rounding`.

lina: sounds like quant scale rounding + kv offset accumulation. is this only with kvcache enabled?

akira: turning off kvcache makes the symptom vanish for the failing examples. disabling per-token scaling (fall back to per-tensor) also reduces rate but impacts perf.

noah: repro command I used: `./eval_harness.sh --model nova-lite-v1 --quant q5x --max-tokens 2048 --kv-cache on --batch 8 --seed 7 --suite mixed_long_jp_kr`

noah: quick triage steps: 1) replicate with `--kv-cache off` and `--workers 1` to isolate sharding effects. 2) add unit that reconstructs offsets using high-precision accumulator (int64) and compare. 3) instrument quant path to log scale values per token for failing samples.

lina: good. I'll add a targeted mixedscript smoke to the CI eval set and a per-locale alert in console that increments on offset-mismatch count.

canary-bot: canary rollout: nova-lite-v1-q5x-canary -> staging by akira at 2026-03-21T09:12Z (2 replicas).

akira: plan: hold any Dedicated rollout until we have a patch. probable fix is to maintain 64-bit offset accumulators in kv-assembly and avoid applying per-token float->int rounding during offset mapping; alternative is to quantize offsets separately (integer-safe path). also add fuzz tests with grapheme clusters spanning subtokens.

noah: I'll draft a small patch that switches accumulator type and add unit tests. will post PR link here.

lina: please add a check in release checklist: run `mixedscript_longctx_smoke` for any quant/kernel changes.

akira: thanks — will follow up with failing sample tarball and minimal reproducer.
